capacity_usable_kwh.notes: EV Database: 74.0 kWh usable of 77.4 nominal (EU listing 2021-2024; same pack).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: EV Database: 697 V nominal, 800 V architecture.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: What a 2022 owner can get today: Kia says the improved battery conditioning is standard from MY23 and a dealer retrofit for MY22 (InsideEVs, Kia Europe quote; North American availability not stated). Post-retrofit behaviour is taken from the 2024 EV6 manual (src-kia-manual-ev6-2024-battery-conditioning: EV Settings switch plus DC-charger-as-destination trigger) and the Kia UK page. The original MY22 software had a more basic navigation pre-conditioning; if the retrofit is not offered in North America the value would be narrower. Battery heater per trim unconfirmed.

dc_max_kw.notes: Wikipedia: 240 kW for the 77.4 kWh pack (Kia claim). EV Database lists 233 kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs relaying Kia US specs: 10.9 kW onboard charger on both 2022 packs (58 and 77.4 kWh). EV Database 11 kW is the EU figure.

published_10_80_min.notes: EV Database: Kia claims 18 min on a 350 kW charger; EVDB table ~17 min.
